headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.23
LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.23
summary: Discord presence gets richer: your Xbox avatar while viewing profiles, a Minecraft logo while playing, and presence that no longer sticks to the launcher screen.

items.text: Viewing an Xbox profile now shows the person's Xbox Live avatar as the presence image, with a button that opens their Xbox profile page.
Playing Minecraft shows the LeviLauncher logo as the main presence image and the Minecraft logo as the small badge.
Presence no longer sticks to the launcher screen after leaving and returning to an Xbox profile.
